tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search wholesale products on B2B Market by keywords (any of ru/uz/en/zh). Returns title, price, seller and page URL. Optionally limit to a product category (see list_categories).

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full details of one product: price, seller, specifications, description, category and similar products.

tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Search business services on B2B Market (logistics, advertising, construction, consulting…). Returns title, price, provider and page URL.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Full details of one service: price, provider, city, description and similar services.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: A seller company on B2B Market: what it sells, its categories, city, and its latest products and services.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Product or service categories with the number of offers in each and the category page URL.

tools.name: list_category_offers
tools.description: Browse one category without keywords: its newest products or services, page by page, with price, seller and page URL, plus the subcategories to narrow down to. Take category_id from list_categories.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Find seller companies on B2B Market by name or keywords, or list the suppliers of one category. Returns name, city, what the company sells, the number of its offers and its page URL. Give query, category_id, or both. Read one company with get_company.
